title: The Entralink's tables: res/field/entralink/luminance.json or forest_levels.json
description: One of the Entralink's archives: luminance.json, ARCID_FIELD_PALACE_SYS (a/2/1/9), the grayscale of another player's worlds (field_palace_sys.c), or forest_levels.json, ARCID_ENTREE_FOREST (a/2/2/3), the Entree Forest's levels (entree_forest.c). tools/data/entralink_data.py packs them.

luminance.description: The four files that FieldPalaceSys_InitPostFX picks from by the area owner's version class (Intrude_GetAreaOwnerVersionClass) and whether the player has been to the world's town (FieldPalaceSys_CheckEventFlag): 0 and 1 for class 2, 2 and 3 for class 1, the second of each once the player has

items.description: A file's entries, a PalaceLuminanceEntry each: FieldPalaceSys_LoadLuminanceTable takes the first from the second on that matches the area and the season, or else the first

area.description: The world, (the zone's area ID - 2) / 4 + 1, or null for any (PALACE_LUMINANCE_ANY)

season.description: The season, or null for any (PALACE_LUMINANCE_ANY)

table.description: The gray, 0 to 31, of each luminance from 0 to 31, which ColorFilter_ApplyLUT draws a color of that luminance in

forest_levels.description: The level, 0 to 100, of each species from SPECIES_NONE on, by its SPECIES_* constant, that EntreeForest_CreateSymbolMon gives an Entree Forest Pokémon of the species
